narrative.details:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine, it stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
narrative.objectives: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, Theinn! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, Theinn. Ye've done champion proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the water yet, Theinn? If ye haven't made the trek to Kalimdor yet, be careful.
